description:
This file declares the abstract class VideoSink, which serves as an interface for handling video frames in a WebRTC streaming context within the cuttlefish project. It includes a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method OnFrame, which is intended to be overridden to process incoming video frames.

It also includes necessary headers and is wrapped in the cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming namespace.

classes.name: VideoSink
classes.description: Abstract class serving as an interface for receiving video frames, with a virtual destructor and an abstract OnFrame method to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: ~VideoSink
methods.description: Destructor for VideoSink class, defaulted virtual destructor.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle incoming video frames, to be implemented by subclasses. Accepts a shared pointer to a VideoFrameBuffer and a timestamp in microseconds.
